component.name: Catarina
component.summary: Offline API client with file-based collections

description.p: Catarina is an offline API client. Collections and requests are versionable .json files on your disk, not records in a remote database.

ul.li: File-based collections you can version with git and share by folder
Secrets in the system keyring, never in the repository
Scoped variables resolved across global, collection and request
Auth, headers, querystring and JSON, text, form or multipart bodies
JSON tree, headers, cookies and a network timeline in the response
Import and export cURL, send history and a command palette

screenshot.caption: Editing a request and inspecting the JSON response

ul.li: CI with tests, secret scan, branch policy, and automatic pull requests.
The default collections folder follows the XDG Documents location.
